questions.q: How long does a team wait today for a new environment to run its application?
questions.why: Platform speed is the main reason teams adopt it.

questions.q: Who is responsible for a cluster's upgrades today, and how far behind are they?
questions.why: Upgrade debt is the most common hidden risk.

questions.q: How many clusters exist, including the ones teams created themselves?
Which workloads keep data in volumes, and is that data backed up?
questions.why: Stateful workloads are the ones that lose data.

questions.q: What stops a team from deploying an unapproved image or a privileged pod?
questions.why: Policy at admission is where security becomes routine.

questions.q: Are changes made through Git, or by hand on the cluster?
questions.why: Hand changes are the source of drift and outages.

questions.q: Could each team tell you what its workloads cost last month?
questions.why: Cost visibility changes behaviour more than budgets.

questions.q: When a node or a workload fails at night, who knows first?
questions.why: Observability without an owner is a dashboard nobody reads.
